title: CLO Import DXF pattern
content:
Hi there, I am having issues importing DXF files (from Creative Studio Gemini) into CLO. What settings do I need to alter? I am not sure what the dotted outline is. Thanks for any guidance. I am using the version 2025.2.190. Thanks.![5129ad71aef94aba80a45af58f2e32b3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/e73487b605cc4cb897041b9e177c3bae/images/5129ad71aef94aba80a45af58f2e32b3Clo%20pattern%20dxf.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: The dotted outline are baselines (inactive construction lines). If you have exhausted all combinations of import options in CLO, then the issue lies with export from the other software. E.g. it might be that the lines that come in as baselines are not fully closed, therefore not recognized as a pattern piece. While the small rectangle that does show up is closed and erroneously recognized as a piece. If it's the only option, you can try if you can trace the baselines as a pattern piece, select them all with the trace tool and right-click onto them. If the lines are not closed, it will not produce the exact shape though.
Reply 1: Great, thanks for that Melody. I have figured it out now.
content_description: This page provides guidance on resolving issues with importing DXF files from Creative Studio Gemini into CLO version 2025.2.190, including explanations of the dotted outline and recommended settings adjustments.

title: Help with folded collar
content:
![2d917b5f44234128a7ad97c46118d489](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/acc1a16a8f47462aa8a6d7b9399a1820/images/2d917b5f44234128a7ad97c46118d489clo%20collar.PNG)Hi there, I have a neck band that is a folded piece. When I render though the inside of the neck band is very dark and I want it to appear more white as per the fabric on the outside of the neck band. I have already changed the back side of the fabric to be white but it doesn't seem to help. Any suggestion for what to check or settings to change would be helpful. Thank you!

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: It appears connected to the light settings. You can either edit the light angle and see if you can get an outcome you prefer, or add e.g. a rectangle light pointing toward the front of the T-shirt to get more even exposure in that direction.
content_description: This web page provides guidance and troubleshooting tips for adjusting fabric appearance in 3D rendering, specifically addressing how to make the inside of a folded neck band appear lighter.
